title: Abrahamic Covenant: smoking oven and flaming torch (brit) — fire in covenant
summary: Under the heading Abrahamic Covenant (ברית אברהם), quotes the scene where a smoking oven and flaming torch pass between the pieces and the LORD (YHVH) makes a covenant (ברית, brit) with Abram, cited on the slide as Genesis 15:15-16. Below, fire (אש, aish) is set beside covenant (ברית, brit).

text.text: It came about when the sun had set, that it was very dark, and behold, there appeared a smoking oven and a flaming torch which passed between these pieces. On that day the LORD (YHVH) made a covenant ברית brit with Abram, saying, “To your descendants I have given this land, From the river of Egypt as far as the great river, the river Euphrates:—

keywords: to your descendants I have given this land
uncertain: The quoted words match Genesis 15:17-18, but the slide cites Genesis 15:15-16 (transcribed as shown).
Some letters in LORD (YHVH) and 'flaming' are coloured; no explanation on this slide.
